readonly.description: Open the file in read-only mode (corresponds to -r / --readonly)

start_offset.description: Position cursor to this byte offset from start of file (corresponds to -s / --start=OFFSET)

file_length.description: Set length of file to this value. Useful for special files where shed cannot obtain length with stat (corresponds to -L / --length=LENGTH)

hex_mode.description: Start in hex mode with hex offsets etc. (corresponds to -H / --hex)
